# WayShowers88

> WayShowers88 is an astrology and tarot YouTube channel (youtube.com/@WayShowers88) and its website, run by Adrian, a filmmaker and tarot reader, with co-creator Kath. The site offers free browser-based astrology tools and paid personalised readings computed from the reader's exact birth chart. Knowledge is free; personalisation is paid.

Free tools run entirely in the visitor's browser: nothing is sent or stored, no sign-up. Paid readings are composed one chart at a time from a verified astronomical engine (not sun-sign templates) and delivered digitally by email. Prices are in Australian dollars.

## Free tools

- [Free Birth Chart Calculator](https://wayshowers88.com/calculator.html): Natal chart with exact planetary degrees, a choice of Placidus or Whole Sign houses, and every major aspect explained in plain English. Computed in the browser, no account needed, savable as PDF.
- [The Moon Clock](https://wayshowers88.com/moon-clock.html): Live clock showing which zodiac sign the Moon is in right now, her exact degree and phase, and when she next changes sign. Requires JavaScript.

## Paid personal readings

- [The Luminary](https://wayshowers88.com/luminary.html): A personalised New Moon or Full Moon reading ($33 AUD). The reader picks a moon; the reading shows which house of their natal chart it falls in and every aspect it makes to their natal planets. Two editions (screen and print). Each moon stays open for orders for three days after it peaks.
- [The Turning Point](https://wayshowers88.com/turningpoint-details.html): A seasonal reading ($44 AUD) covering one quarter of the year (first edition: equinox to solstice) against the reader's birth chart: the major transits with their dates, retrograde stations timed to the reader's houses, and one dated turning point for the season.
- [The Written Sky](https://wayshowers88.com/painted-skies.html#written): A natal star map in a painted sky plus six reading plates ($44 AUD): every placement to the arcminute, the Sun, Moon and rising sign read individually and together, the seven strongest aspects, and the lunar nodes.
- [The Painted Skies](https://wayshowers88.com/painted-skies.html): A natal star map ($33 AUD) set in a choice of painted skies (Moonrise, Silver River, Golden Tide), with the birth moon phase and an optional gift dedication.
